title: Find the Difference of Two Arrays
summary: Given two 0-indexed integer arrays nums1 and nums2, return a list answer of size 2, where: - answer[0] is a list of all distinct integers in nums1 that are not present in nums2.
statement: Given two 0-indexed integer arrays nums1 and nums2, return a list answer of size 2, where: - answer[0] is a list of all distinct integers in nums1 that are not present in nums2. - answer[1] is a list of all distinct integers in nums2 that are not present in nums1. The order of the elements within each list is not specified.
constraints: Return two rows: values unique to nums1, then values unique to nums2.
Each row contains distinct integers only.
Order inside either row does not matter, but the two row meanings may not be swapped.
hints: Set subtraction directly expresses values present in one array but absent in the other.
Convert both arrays to sets to remove duplicates before subtracting.
Each difference contains exactly the required membership predicate and set semantics guarantee no duplicate output values.
editorial: Each difference contains exactly the required membership predicate and set semantics guarantee no duplicate output values.

tests.explanation: The first-only values are one and three; the second-only values are four and six.
Only three is absent from the second array, while no value is unique to the second.
